title: LURE: a Phase-Labelled Synthetic Corpus of Online-Grooming Exchanges
abstract: arXiv:2610.15908v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Phase-annotated conversational data is essential for studying the progression of online grooming of minors and for developing early warning tools. However, the only publicly available source (i.e., Perverted-Justice archive, which contains a subset coded using ChatCoder) is small, outdated, and frozen. We present a synthetic corpus of groomer-victim exchanges, generated using a retrieval-augmented pipeline running on institutional hardware. This pipeline uses an openly available, eight-billion-parameter, refusal-ablated language model. The corpus was created using the five stages of the responsible-generation protocol for synthetic datasets: ontology-driven design based on the ChatCoder luring-communication scheme (eight communicative tags mapped onto four grooming phases); multi-model prompt testing; human-in-the-loop supervision; semantic and feature-level validation; and modality-aware documentation. The released corpus contains 2,121

translated_title: LURE：一个带阶段标注的网络诱拐对话合成语料库
translated_abstract: 带阶段标注的对话数据对于研究针对未成年人的网络诱拐的发展过程以及开发早期预警工具至关重要。然而，目前唯一公开可用的数据源（即 Perverted-Justice 档案，其中包含一个使用 ChatCoder 编码的子集）规模小、过时且已冻结不再更新。我们提出了一个诱拐者-受害者对话的合成语料库，该语料库通过在机构硬件上运行的检索增强流水线生成。该流水线使用了一个公开可用的、80亿参数、经过拒答消融处理的语言模型。该语料库按照合成数据集负责任生成协议的五个阶段创建：基于 ChatCoder 诱拐通信方案的本体驱动设计（将八个交际标签映射到四个诱拐阶段）；多模型提示词测试；人在回路监督；语义和特征级验证；以及考虑模态的文档化。所发布的语料库包含 2,121……（摘要原文截断）
tldr: 该论文通过检索增强流水线和一个80亿参数的拒答消融语言模型，按照五阶段负责任生成协议，构建并公开了首个带诱拐阶段标注的网络诱拐对话合成语料库，弥补了现有唯一真实数据源规模小、过时且冻结的不足。
